newsitem.title: USA: Nalco Chemical says to buy Albright unit.
newsitem.headline: Nalco Chemical says to buy Albright unit.

text.p: Nalco Chemical Co said on Monday it had signed a letter of intent to buy the water treatment service chemical business of U.K.-based Albright & Wilson. Terms were not disclosed.
Albright & Wilson's 1996 sales of water treatment chemicals are expected to total about $5 million, according to a Nalco statement announcing the transaction.
Albright sells water treatment chemicals in the United Kingdom to steel companies, electric utilities and others.
Nalco Chemical, with 1995 sales of $1.2 billion, makes water treatment and process chemicals and services.
Nalco shares on Monday were trading at 37-7/8, down 1/8. Albright shares closed in London on Monday at 184p (U.K.), off 3-1/2p from Friday's close.
